en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdullah al-Barqi narrated to us from Isma`il b. Mehran from Sayf b. `Amira from Sulayman b. Ja`far al-Nakha`I from Muhammad b. Muslim and others from Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) was asked about the best of worshipers, so he said:

Those whom, if they do good, they are gladdened; and if they do evil, they seek forgiveness; and if they are given, they are thankful; and if they face calamity, they are patient; and if they get angry, they seek pardon.
